A study on the water situation in Iraq
 
Introduction
As a country at the mouth of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, Iraq faces a complex water crisis that is considered one of the most serious national challenges that threaten economic, social, and health security.
This crisis is the result of a combination of regional factors (reducing water releases from upstream countries).

Text_en: With our warmest congratulations and sincere blessings, we congratulate the brothers in the Islamic Dawa Party on the success of their electoral conference and the renewed confidence in Mr. #Nouri_Al-Maliki as Secretary-General of the party. We ask God Almighty to grant them more success and success, and we look forward to more fruitful cooperation for the sake of the pride of Iraq and the service of our people.

From the era of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) to Malik al-Ashtar (may God be pleased with him):
